title: Elevated 5xx errors on storage-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on storage-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] storage-svc 2026-06-15 18:33-23:23: storage-svc: 283 of 386 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-15 18:33 and 2026-06-15 23:23 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.
error_templates: Call to node-svc failed: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable

_templates.macro: Launch-template change moved {svc} to a smaller instance type.

culprit.diff:
@@ -126,3 +126,3 @@ aws_launch_template.node_svc
 resource "aws_launch_template" "node_svc" {
-  instance_type = "m5.4xlarge"
+  instance_type = "m5.xlarge"
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Launch-template change moved node-svc to a smaller instance type.
rca.micro: infra/node-svc.tf:127 sets instance_type m5.4xlarge -> m5.xlarge on aws_launch_template.node_svc.
rca.remediation: Restore instance_type = m5.4xlarge on aws_launch_template.node_svc (terraform tf-r11).

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `Call to node-svc failed: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`.
